title: Records and recording quality
summary: Whether care plans, daily notes and medicines records are accurate, up to date and consistent between carers.
whenToUse: Every quarter, or when audits find gaps in notes or MAR records.

statements.focus: Care plans up to date and matching what carers actually do.
MAR records: gaps, codes and PRN notes.
Daily notes clear enough for the next carer to follow.
Notes written about the person, not just tasks.
Care record audits and their actions.
